Create contrast legend

Source: R/method_Legend.R
create_contrast_legend.Rd

Create a legend for a layer that contrasts differences between two or more prioritizations.

Usage

create_contrast_legend(
  project,
  name1,
  name2,
  values = NULL,
  zone_colors = get_golem_config("zone_colors"),
  zone_locked_colors = get_golem_config("zone_locked_colors")
)

Arguments

project

new_project() object.

name1

character value with the name of a new_solution().

name2

character value with the name of a new_solution().

values

numeric vector with values to include in the legend. Defaults to NULL such that the legend contains values for all possible similarities and differences between the solutions.

zone_colors

character vector of colors for each zone. Defaults to get_golem_config("zone_colors").

zone_locked_colors

character vector of colors for each zone. Defaults to get_golem_config("zone_locked_colors").

Value

A new_categorical_legend() object.
